title: Computational Model of Flower Pattern Evolution Predicts Spontaneous Emergence of Boundary Cell Types Across Petal Epidermis
authors: Oud S; Żurowski MM; van der Jagt PL; Yeo MTS; Walker JF; Moyroud E; Vroomans RMA
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算模型模拟花瓣图案进化中的基因调控网络，虽涉及转录因子和细胞类型分化，但核心是图案演化而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且方法为GRN模拟而非AI或物理模拟，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Petal patterns play an important role in the reproductive success of flowering plants by attracting pollinators and protecting reproductive organs from environmental factors. Some transcription factors (TFs) that control pigment production and cuticle elaboration in petal epidermal cells have been identified. However, little is known about the upstream developmental processes that pre-pattern the petal surface to first establish the different domains where these regulators will later be expressed. Here, we developed a computational model of the evolution and development of petal patterns to investigate this early pre-patterning phase. We selected for gene regulatory networks (GRNs) that could divide the petal surface into proximal and distal domains to create a bullseye, a very common type of petal pattern across the angiosperms. The evolved GRNs showed robust patterning dynamics and could generate a variety of bullseye proportions. We found that the evolution of bullseye patterns was often accompanied by the spontaneous emergence of a third cell type with a unique gene expression profile at the boundary between the proximal and distal regions. These bullseye boundary cells appeared in most simulations despite not being explicitly selected for, and we validated their presence experimentally in Hibiscus trionum , a model system whose flowers display a bullseye pattern. Although boundary cell types emerged spontaneously in our simulations, they evolved more often and were more important for pattern formation when gene expression was modelled as a noisy process. This suggests that GRNs producing this emergent cell type may support reproducible bullseye formation by buffering against developmental variability. Altogether, the results from our evolutionary simulations illuminate the early steps of petal pattern formation and demonstrate that novel cell types can arise spontaneously and repeatedly from selection on other cell types when developmental robustness is considered.
abstract_zh: 花瓣图案在开花植物的繁殖成功中扮演重要角色，通过吸引传粉者和保护生殖器官免受环境因素影响。已鉴定出一些控制花瓣表皮细胞中色素产生和角质层精细结构的转录因子（TFs）。然而，关于上游发育过程如何预先图案化花瓣表面，以首先建立这些调控因子随后将表达的不同区域，目前知之甚少。在此，我们开发了一个花瓣图案进化与发育的计算模型，以研究这一早期预图案化阶段。我们选择了能够将花瓣表面划分为近轴和远轴区域以形成牛眼图案的基因调控网络（GRNs），这是被子植物中一种非常常见的花瓣图案类型。进化出的GRNs表现出稳健的图案化动力学，并能生成多种牛眼比例。我们发现，牛眼图案的进化通常伴随着在近轴和远轴区域边界处自发出现具有独特基因表达谱的第三种细胞类型。这些牛眼边界细胞在大多数模拟中出现，尽管并未被明确选择，并且我们在Hibiscus trionum（一种其花朵显示牛眼图案的模型系统）中实验验证了它们的存在。尽管边界细胞类型在我们的模拟中自发出现，但当基因表达被建模为噪声过程时，它们更频繁地进化且对图案形成更为重要。这表明产生这种新兴细胞类型的GRNs可能通过缓冲发育变异性来支持可重复的牛眼形成。总体而言，我们进化模拟的结果阐明了花瓣图案形成的早期步骤，并证明在考虑发育稳健性时，新细胞类型可以从对其他细胞类型的选择中自发且重复地产生。
